errors.text: The proposed screw-dislocation kink-pair mechanism is imported from a BCC MoNbTaW refractory HEA and is not valid evidence for yielding in FCC FeNiCrMn.

The hypothesis rejects defect-controlled dislocation nucleation, whereas the target mechanism is nucleation at vacancy clusters or disordered sites followed by Shockley-partial slip and stacking-fault formation.
It does not identify the required crystallographic anisotropy, particularly the maximum yield stress along the <-111> loading direction.
It replaces the simulated 10 K to 600 K and 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1 regime with a less specific 77 K to 600 K range and unspecified strain rates.
